oneOf.description: Resolve a tap on the current draft, including earlier wires. Optional net or member restricts the intended Net; a tap joining a different crossing Net is rejected.
Net ID or name; choose its nearest route to the other endpoint on the current draft.

Opt-in, bounded one-pass placement of visible default Instance labels. Compact/collision avoidance default true. Preserve manually positioned (unless includeManual), locked and custom-styled labels, bindings and electrical names, and name those left in place (LABELS_LEFT_IN_PLACE); unresolved clashes remain observations.
A figure's label convention in one step and one undo. Nothing hidden is shown; labels arrange-labels leaves alone keep their place and look.

commands.description: Ordered atomic route-net, power rail, label, model, display, annotation move, direction, VDD mode, bulk default or terminal removal commands; one undo, no partial commit. Total expanded edit limit still applies.

instances.description: A part without a reference takes the next free name, as a GUI insert does.

pinAnchors.description: By new Instance ID. Solves placement.position from this pin; preserves rotation/mirror. No implicit connection.

displays.description: By new device Instance ID: its labels from the start. Left out, the name shows alone; showValue:true shows the value given, else the catalog default (#1435).

placement.description: Origin and orientation. With pinAnchor only the orientation is read; left out, the part goes upright and unmirrored.

oneOf.description: Arrange this Cell's block Pins by name. Pins not named keep their place; callers keep their Nets and their wiring is redrawn.

__schema252.description: Change one part as Apply in Properties does, through the same planner: a moved part joins a pin it lands on, as a drag does.

__schema254.description: The part's Reference; for a Cell Pin, the Pin's name.

__schema258.description: A formula block's drawing; null clears a field.

__schema260.description: A block's supply Net by ID; null returns it to Auto.

__schema262.description: A controlled source's control; null clears it.

__schema264.description: A current source's outline (current-source, vccs, cccs): circle, the default, or diamond. Its netlist, pins and wires stay.

reflect.description: Reflect in place: y flips left-right, x top-bottom.

__schema267.description: Exact routing grid landing, not artwork contact. Unreachable positions are rejected with the nearest reachable landing.

__schema274.description: Line up part origins on one coordinate (the first part's when left out).

__schema279.description: Free one pin from its Net, as its menu does: Delete connection where wires end on it, Disconnect endpoint where none does.

__schema282.description: Explicit selection. Includes owned displays and formal interface declarations, and, as in the GUI, a wire that only tapped a deleted part into other wiring. Select all object IDs for complete Cell deletion.

reference.description: X and a number; omit it for the next free one, as the GUI names a Cell instance.

__schema287.description: When supplied, solves the origin instead of using placement.position; keeps orientation.

target.description: Current Net ID/name, member pin, explicit pins to join, or an original import-reference Net. Routes only missing visible connections.

trunk.description: Straight horizontal/vertical trunk; otherwise use MST guidance. Atomic, not an obstacle autorouter.

__schema295.description: Move an existing Junction and reshape every incident Route atomically; preserve connectivity and respect protected geometry.

__schema299.description: The Cell's NMOS or PMOS body default, as its settings in Properties set it: bodies on the old default move to the Net; wired bodies stay.

__schema302.description: Net ID or name; null clears the default.

__schema305.description: Show text on a part's name label while the part keeps its own Reference (or Pin name) in the netlist, e.g. an op-amp X1 drawn A1; null shows its own name again. Survives Project Code and Copy as the label's text.

text.description: Plain text takes the label's standard look (VB1 reads V over a B1 subscript); RichText sets its own.

__schema311.description: Absolute drawing position; preserve electrical binding and object ownership.

__schema313.description: Which end of the text stands at position: start (text to its right), middle or end; omitted keeps the label's.

scope.description: Defaults to the existing Net scope, otherwise local; global must be intentional.

__schema317.description: Set a straight Power Rail's two ends on its own line. Taps and the one label stay; no pin is joined.

__schema325.description: Also re-place labels moved by hand.

__schema327.description: Side tried first; outside = away from the drawing's centre line, mirrored halves.

__schema330.description: textbook: MOS W/L hidden, other values left as they are, names in their role look (R_L, I_SS, M_1) and labels arranged as arrange-labels arranges them.

__schema331.description: Left out: every placed part of the Cell.

offset.description: From the side's middle, a multiple of 10. Left out: a Pin keeping its side stays put, one changing side takes the first free slot (0, -20, 20, …).
